item.title: Allica Bank joins the fintech unicorn club after $155M Series D round
item.description: London-based digital challenger bank Allica Bank has officially crossed the unicorn threshold after closing a $155 million Series D funding round that valued the company at around $1.2 billion. This places the fintech among the growing list of private companies with valuations above $1 billion, alongside peers such as Revolut, Monzo, Starling and Zilch. item.title: AI training efficiency: From Throughput to Goodput
item.description: Pretraining a modern large language model (LLM), often with ~100B parameters or more, typically involves thousands of accelerators and massive token corpora, running for days to months. At that scale, success is commonly reduced to two headline outcomes: Speed: how fast the system consumes training data, usually measured in tokens/second. item.title: Callosum raises $10.25 million to challenge entrenched AI compute models
item.description: London-based AI software startup Callosum has closed a $10.25 million funding round led by European early-stage venture fund Plural, marking a notable bet on multi-chip AI infrastructure at a time when venture capital remains heavily concentrated in a narrow set of compute platform plays. item.title: AI agents, outdated training and live search grounding
item.description: An AI assistant is asked a simple question: has this company changed its CEO? It responds confidently, citing information that was accurate a few months ago. The problem is that the leadership changed last week. This is the structural limitation of many AI systems today. item.title: German AI foodtech startup Foodforecast raises €8 Million to cut ultra-fresh food waste
item.description: Cologne-based Foodforecast, a startup using artificial intelligence to improve how food with short shelf lives is forecast and produced, has raised €8 million in a Series A funding round as it scales across Europe. item.title: ElevenLabs and Google Cloud expand AI partnership with NVIDIA Blackwell GPU support
item.description: ElevenLabs, the London-based voice-AI specialist, has deepened its strategic partnership with Google Cloud to tap into expanded cloud infrastructure and the latest accelerated computing from NVIDIA, including Blackwell-class GPUs. Announced on February 26, this multi-year agreement aims to help ElevenLabs scale its voice synthesis and conversational-agent products for large-enterprise use cases. item.title: Proxima Fusion seeks €2 Billion to build a nuclear fusion test facility
item.description: Proxima Fusion, a Munich-based nuclear energy startup, has outlined plans to raise about €2 billion to build a major fusion test facility in Germany that could be a milestone on the path to commercially viable fusion power. item.title: Nobel Recruitment acquires Berlin’s ARRtist to expand German tech community
item.description: European go-to-market search firm Nobel Recruitment has acquired Berlin-based ARRtist, a practitioner-led tech community platform for founders, C-level executives and investors. The deal strengthens Nobel’s position in Germany while expanding its reach beyond executive search into community building and ecosystem development. Financial terms were not disclosed. item.title: Why the “AI Is Easy to Trick” Narrative Misses
item.description: A recent article published by the BBC explored how generative AI tools could be “hacked” within minutes by introducing newly published online content. item.title: Accessibility Redefined
